Question01.question: What is the primary indicator of a spoofed sender address in an email?
Question01.optionA: The email has a high-priority red exclamation flag
Question01.optionB: The display name shows a senior executive, but the actual domain does not match official company domains
Question01.optionC: The email contains a footer disclaimer
Question01.optionD: The subject line is written in lowercase

Question02.optionA: Hover over the hyperlink to inspect the true destination URL
Question02.optionB: Click it immediately to verify if the website is active
Question02.optionC: Forward the link to all team members for opinion
Question02.optionD: Reply to the sender asking if the link is safe

Question01.optionA: Approve one so the notifications stop
